---
title: "Knowledge Graph Explorer"
subtitle: "Interactive force-directed graph of all conceptual frameworks and typed connections."
page-layout: full
---

```{=html}
<script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script>
<script src="assets/frameworks-app.js"></script>

<div style="max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1rem 0;">
  <p style="color: #64748b; font-size: 0.95rem;">
    Explore relationships between frameworks. <strong>Click a node</strong> to inspect and highlight its connections; <strong>double-click</strong> to visit its page. Drag nodes to explore cluster dynamics.
  </p>

  <div class="graph-viewport-container" style="height: 650px;">
    <div class="graph-controls">
      <span style="font-weight: 600; color: #475569;">Full Network Map</span>
      <span style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #94a3b8;">Zoom & Pan Enabled</span>
    </div>
    <div id="main-graph-canvas" style="width: 100%; height: 650px;"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Legend -->
  <div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 2rem; margin-top: 1.25rem; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #475569;">
    <span style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;">
      <span style="width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ef4444; display: inline-block;"></span> Law
    </span>
    <span style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;">
      <span style="width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #10b981; display: inline-block;"></span> Policy
    </span>
    <span style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;">
      <span style="width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3b82f6; display: inline-block;"></span> Economics
    </span>
    <span style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;">
      <span style="width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #8b5cf6; display: inline-block;"></span> Society
    </span>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  // Ensure the graph renders on dedicated page
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      renderMainGraph();
    }, 200);
  });
</script>
```
